_comment: Illustrative fixture for the design note 'AWP semantic inheritance for guarded work' (android_sports_watches/docs/awp-semantic-inheritance-design-note.md). Not wired into this repo's own self-hosted CI gate -- config/awp-action-boundary/{guardrails,decisions,protected-paths}.json intentionally stay generic to this repo's own protected-artifacts/** path. See tools/awp_taxonomy.py and tests/test_taxonomy.py / tests/test_awp_action_boundary.py::ConceptInheritanceTests for the resolver this feeds.
